review_candidates.description: Description About Alvarez & Marsal Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M. The Team Our Highly Respected Infrastructure & Capital Projects (A&M INFRA) Team Is Built On Deep Industry Sector Expertise With a Demonstrably Differentiated Ability To Address The Most Complex Problems Facing Our Public And Private Sector Clients. Our Multi-disciplinary Team Solving High-stakes Issues For Our Clients Across The Capital Project And Infrastructure Deal Lifecycles. We Are Focused On Improving Outcomes On Capital Projects, Mitigating Risks And Protecting Value By Reducing The Level Of Uncertainty Associated With The Development, Delivery And Operation Of Programmes And Projects. We Combine Strategic And Operational Expertise With a Deep Technical Knowledge To Support Developers, Sponsors, Lenders, And Operators To Drive Value Improvements Across The End-to-end Infrastructure Life-cycle Covering Capital Strategy, Capital Efficiency & Portfolio Value Creation Deal Advisory & Due-Diligence Project Development / Business Case Procurement Advisory Project Delivery & Construction Advisory (incl. Disputes) Transition to Operations Asset Management & Optimisation A&M INFRA is further expanding in Southeast Asia, and we are looking to recruit an Assistant Director / Director to join our fast-growing practice. Working alongside some of the industry's brightest minds and most experienced colleagues, you will have an active role in the development and execution of client assignments and contributing to our success. As a senior member of the team, you can expect responsibility for delivering assignments to clients involved in complex infrastructure and capital projects. Such assignments range from helping clients set up programmes through to delivery of projects, transformations and turnarounds through outcome-focused advice and support. You will support business development activities, support strategies, manage projects and client relationships, and the development of earlier-in-career team members. Reporting to senior leadership, you will help ensure with paramount importance that we deliver timely and quality advice to our clients. How You Will Contribute Collaborate closely with clients to understand their specific needs and develop tailored solutions that align with their business goals and objectives. Lead and actively contribute to energy and infrastructure projects throughout their lifecycle, from inception to completion, ensuring high-quality delivery and client satisfaction. Conduct market research and analysis to identify emerging trends, opportunities, and challenges in the energy and infrastructure sector, providing valuable insights to clients. Lead the execution of project workstreams, demonstrating expertise and effectively managing core components of projects including work plan, staffing, deadlines and scope or budget issues. Conduct meetings and presentations with clients, as well as internal managerial and executive stakeholders, showcasing proficiency and confidence in discussing project matters. Collaborate with teams and clients, engaging in negotiations and fostering effective partnerships between leadership Actively engage in business development activities, including identifying new project opportunities, nurturing client relationships, and expanding our client base across the region. Leverage your extensive network and relationships with industry players, government agencies, banks, and lenders to generate leads and drive business growth. Develop and nurture client relationships, seeking to understand their needs and contributing to their satisfaction. Participate in industry events and associations to broaden professional connections and identify potential growth avenues. Contribute to the identification and pursuit of new business prospects, aligned with the strategic goals of I&CP and other Business Units. Drive project analyses, propose actionable plans, and exhibit strong decision-making capabilities. Demonstrate leadership qualities while effectively guiding project delivery. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental sciences, business, or a related field. MBA is preferred. Proven track record and 8+ years of experience with a strong focus on capital strategy, capital delivery and asset optimization. Extensive understanding of the energy and infrastructure market in the SEA region, including market dynamics, policy frameworks, and emerging trends. Demonstrated expertise in strategy development, techno-economic modeling, due diligence, energy transition planning, and decarbonization strategies. Well-established network and relationships with industry players, government agencies, banks, and lenders in the SEA region. Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to effectively lead and deliver multiple projects simultaneously. Analytical mindset and proficiency in data analysis, with experience in utilizing modeling tools and software. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas and concepts to clients and stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations and develop solutions, emphasizing creativity and critical thinking. Self-starter with strong business acumen and a results-driven approach. Experience with internal project leadership of small teams and the ability to mentor junior staff. Collaborative and team-oriented mindset. Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with senior management, clients, and colleagues. Entrepreneurial mindset with ambition and risk appetite. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Developing client management skills and aptitude for business development and negotiation. Thrives in a high-energy, fast-paced, and dynamic culture. Your journey at A&M We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

review_candidates.title: Assistant Commercial Manager
review_candidates.description: Role: Assistant Commercial Manager Location: London, Milton Keynes or Birmingham (Hybrid) Grade: G14 Base Salary : £45,000 - £50,000 per annum (Birmingham) £50,000 - £55,000 per annum (London) Close Date: 3rd October 2026 Job Description: Base salary £45,000pa to c.£55,0000pa depending on skills, experience and location. In addition, we offer flexible benefits fund of 15% which is paid on top base salary and is fully pensionable, as well as a range of competitive benefits - check them out in the Benefits section on our website. HS2 Ltd endeavours to ensure everyone working for us and with us feels included, thrives and achieves their full potential. In practice, this means we are positive and inclusive about making adjustments, providing flexible working, encouraging our staff networks to flourish and providing personal and professional development opportunities. As an Assistant Commercial Manager at HS2 you will have a key role in supporting the delivery of support the delivery of HS2’s strategic goals by building value-adding supply chains with sustainable commercial relationships. About the role: This role supports the commercial management of delivery projects, working closely with contractors and the supply chain to ensure effective commercial control, value for money, and successful project delivery. The position provides commercial assurance and independent oversight to support the Head of Commercial. Key Responsibilities: Support the commercial management of HS2 contracts throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring effective commercial control, value for money, and alignment with strategic objectives. Assist in the procurement and award of contracts in a fair, transparent, and compliant manner, ensuring all contractual requirements are delivered on time. Build and maintain strong, value-adding relationships with contractors, suppliers, and the wider supply chain to support successful project delivery. Support the development of commercial documentation, works information, contract management plans, and contract documents. Provide commercial advice and support across contracts, helping to ensure compliance with contractual obligations, governance requirements, and project objectives. Assist with the administration and management of NEC3 contracts, including monitoring obligations, maintaining commercial records, and supporting contractual processes. Support the assessment of variations, compensation events, contract payments, and cost estimates to ensure effective financial management. Review and analyse supplier performance, monthly reports, and contract performance data, contributing to management reporting and commercial decision-making. Assist in negotiating commercial agreements, coordinating interfaces across suppliers and contracts, and supporting the resolution of commercial and supply chain disputes. Ensure the organisation has the goods, services, and commercial arrangements required to support each stage of the delivery lifecycle. Promote and embed Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) principles in all activities while complying with organisational policies, procedures, and initiatives. About You: Skills Ability to administer contracts to deliver infrastructure or similar capital projects and programmes. Ability to develop commercial policies, processes and procedures. Experience Previous experience administering contracts to deliver infrastructure or similar projects and programmes. Ability to demonstrate an understanding of dispute resolution processes and procedures. Ability to demonstrate an understanding of common commercial policies, processes and procedures. A knowledge of contract, commercial and risk management methods Experience of using commercial management and reporting systems. It is expected that you will actively promote and embed Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) in all your work and support and comply with all organisational initiatives, policies and procedures on EDI. As HS2 Ltd do not hold a sponsorship license from the Home Office, we are not able to provide sponsorship to any applicant. Applicants must already have the Right to Work in the UK at the time of application and our process involves a Right to Work validation prior to the interview stage. Note, there are certain types of time-bound visas that we cannot accept. Any offers made to applicants will be subject to satisfactory completion of pre-employment checks which include Nationality & Immigration Status, employment references, DBS, Financial and Education checks. We ask for a variety of detail in your online application, however we perform the first assessment of suitability for a role based solely on the information in your CV. In a further development of our efforts to create a more diverse workforce, your CV will be anonymised and personal information will be removed during the first stage of the application review. This removes bias from the process and makes it even more important that you attach an updated word version of your CV for each new application ensuring you include evidence directly related to the criteria in the job advert. About Us High Speed 2 (HS2 Ltd) will be the UK’s new high speed rail network. As well as improving capacity, the new scheme will shorten journey times between a number of Britain’s major population centres, boost the economy and create thousands of jobs. HS2 Ltd will create a skills legacy and develop a diverse range of talent. We aim to be a leader in EDI practice by creating a safe & inclusive working environment for all our staff - living our values of Safety, Respect, Integrity and Leadership. In practice, this means we are positive and inclusive about making adjustments, providing flexible working, encouraging our staff networks to flourish and providing personal and professional development opportunities. HS2 Ltd is also a safety-critical organisation. Employees are required to ensure reasonable care of their own and others’ health and safety by taking personal responsibility for working to our ‘Safe at Heart’ programme principles and following safe working procedures at all times. HS2 Ltd endeavours to ensure everyone working for us and with us feels included, thrives and achieves their full potential.
